positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped build and maintain a custom student information system that replaced a costly legacy vendor and supported core workflows across recruitment, research, course management, and operations. Worked across the full stack with React, Ruby on Rails, MySQL, and AWS-backed workflows to ship features, improve data accuracy, optimize performance, and automate manual processes. Designed secure permission-based access controls, built external integrations, and collaborated closely with stakeholders to turn evolving operational needs into practical, user-centered software.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Gained a deep understanding of development frameworks and fundamentals of front-end technologies (React, TypeScript) and back-end technologies (Python). Extensively researched information to improve applications. Worked collaboratively and promoted an inclusive team environment by seeking and offering feedback, focusing on accomplishments, and sharing product and technical knowledge across the company.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:

positions.title: Student Technology Consultant
